text:
maya: quick check 1 00000000 We need a final decision on how tenant info flows in SDKs for pagination + retries. header on transport vs explicit arg? pros/cons?

leo: transport default is nicer ergonomics. Client set-once and forget.

tori: agree but require clear precedence: explicit call arg > client default > incoming header. prevents surprises.

sam: retry budgeting: default scope = api_key. allow client override to 'tenant' scope. docs should warn about untrusted proxies.

ciara: resume tokens must include tenant fingerprint. otherwise resume across tenants -> bad. propose base64url(json({cursor, t:h})) with h=sha1(tenant)[:8]. SDK verifies.

maya: streaming reconnects need tenant too. include tenant in reconnect headers.

leo: SDK placement: token helpers + hint parser live in SDK core package (py/ts/go). keep tiny.

tori: backend contract: add `x-cursor-stable: 1|0` and `x-retry-hint: budget=tenant;max_ms=1500` (advisory). SDK auto-retry only when cursor_stable=1 or client forces it.

infra-bot: created ticket EPIC-1420 "sdk-tenant-prop-pagination" https://redwood.internal/t/EPIC-1420

maya: action items: leo -> client builder PR (set_default_tenant, set_budget_scope). ciara -> token spec + example encoders. sam -> doc draft on retry semantics. reconvene Wed. thanks :thumbsup:
